title: WHITEJACK5/RPTracer

title: goruck/home-generative-agent

title: artokun/comfyui-mcp-panel
description: The local-first sidebar AI agent for ComfyUI — runs on your own Claude OR ChatGPT subscription (no API keys, no extra LLM costs). Drives your live graph: edits, workflows & installs in natural language. The panel UI for comfyui-mcp, the agent-native control plane for ComfyUI.

title: MrWangJustToDo/MyAgent

title: Osmantic/ODS
description: Turn your PC, Mac, or Linux box into an AI server.  LLM inference, chat UI, voice, agents, workflows, RAG, and image generation.

title: Mesh-LLM/mesh-llm
description: Distributed AI/LLM for the people. Share compute privately or publicly to power your agents and chat.

title: anis-marrouchi/agentx
description: AI operations layer for small & medium businesses. Route Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack, Discord, GitLab, crons, webhooks, and mesh tasks to AI agents on Claude, OpenAI, or any LLM. Web wizard for non-technical operators, CLI for engineers. Self-hosted.

title: yauntyour/cell.cpp
description: A lightweight AI coding agent written in modern C++26. Connect to OpenAI or Anthropic, chat with your codebase, and let the LLM read, write, edit, and execute — all sandboxed.

title: choreographr/choreographr
description: Choreographr is an all purpose extensible AI agent system written entirely in Rust. It has a client/server architecture and can run many sessions simulataneously. title: JetBrains/junie
description: An AI coding agent by JetBrains that ships code from your terminal, IDE, or CI/CD pipeline - powered by any LLM you choose

title: rajdeepchatale/agentpay-india

title: open-multi-agent/open-multi-agent
description: TypeScript AI agent orchestration framework with dynamic workflows. Describe the goal, not the graph: a coordinator plans the task DAG at runtime and runs it on any LLM (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, or local models).

title: tjpoisal/UNIMATRIX
description: Unimatrix is a cloud-native AI memory system that gives any LLM instant, persistent context across devices and sessions. Dual-layer mem, hybrid retrieval w/ recency decay, a Librarian agent, and enterprise encryption.

title: jdorner/palim
description: Self-hosted AI agent platform with extensions, workflows, and a web UI. Local LLM inference via llama.cpp (or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint).

title: adecubed/gigamail
description: Mail for AI agents ( and humans). MCP server giving Claude (or any agent) safe, permission-controlled access to email (Microsoft Graph + IMAP), calendar and your knowledge files. title: 99percentgrip/agent-vesper

title: artokun/comfyui-mcp
description: Local-first, agent-native control plane for ComfyUI — MCP server + sidebar agent that generates images, video & audio, authors and runs workflows, and edits your live graph in natural language on ANY LLM (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, offline Ollama, or any hosted model). 178 tools, 36 AI skills, 55 installer packs. title: bgill55/daedalus
description: Daedalus is a standalone terminal-based AI coding assistant that runs on your machine. title: haseebhassan-cloud/sql-ai-agent
description: A text-to-SQL AI agent with a safety-first validation layer. Natural language questions become SQL, but a strict allow-list validator guarantees an LLM can never modify or damage the database. Python, SQLite, Claude API.

title: doctorzero666/HireNet
